title.zh-CN: 骨肿瘤治疗后发热、双腿疼痛 · 6岁女孩
title.en: Fever and leg pain after treatment for a bone tumour · 6-year-old girl

summary.zh-CN: 一个6岁女孩，曾在外院按骨肿瘤化疗，之后评估为完全缓解；近两周发热、两条腿疼，已经不能走路。
summary.en: A 6-year-old girl who had chemotherapy elsewhere for a bone tumour, and was assessed afterwards as in complete remission, now has two weeks of fever and pain in both legs and can no longer walk.

notes.zh-CN: 依据一篇已发表的单例报告改写。患者事实沿用1.0.0版从报告中提取的内容：年龄和性别；首次发病（左下肢和右上臂疼痛、局部肿胀、活动受限，当时无发热、无贫血，血常规正常，没有记录骨髓检查）；外院尤文肉瘤的诊断及其病理（骨破坏，小圆细胞肿瘤，CD99、FLI-1、CD3阳性，CD20阴性，没有TdT记录）；6个疗程化疗后评估为完全缓解；这次发热2周、双下肢疼痛、不能行走；入院查体和血常规；骨髓、流式细胞术和病理复核；重新分类；以及到报告发表时的治疗反应。这些事实尚未对照原文全文核对。患者为化名，医院、日历日期和身份细节已去除，时间以相对时间表示。陪同的家属、对话、阶段、决策、处置选项、评分、教学要点和医护人物是教学设计；没有记录的内容保持未知。按记录保留的疑点：血红蛋白写作7.1 g/L（很可能是单位或录入错误，未作改动）；首次活检CD3阳性；主诉写“再次发热”，而首次发病时并无发热。
notes.en: Adapted from one published case report. The patient facts are those extracted for version 1.0.0: age and sex; the first illness (pain, local swelling and restricted movement of the left leg and right upper arm, no fever or anaemia then, a normal blood count, no recorded marrow examination); the outside diagnosis of Ewing sarcoma and its pathology (bone destruction, small round cell tumour, CD99, FLI-1 and CD3 positive, CD20 negative, no TdT recorded); six courses of chemotherapy and an assessment of complete remission; two weeks of fever and pain in both legs with inability to walk; the admission findings and blood count; the marrow, flow cytometry and pathology review; the reclassification; and the treatment response up to publication. They have not yet been checked against the full article. The patient has a pseudonym; hospitals, calendar dates and identifying details are removed, and times are relative. The relative who accompanies her, the dialogue, phases, decisions, management options, scoring, teaching points and staff are teaching design; what the case does not record stays unknown. Points kept as recorded: the haemoglobin written as 7.1 g/L (probably a unit or transcription error, left unchanged); the CD3 positivity of the first biopsy; and the Chinese chief complaint's “fever again” although the first illness had no fever.

BSH 2016: Guidelines on transfusion for fetuses, neonates and older children (2020 addendum)

notes.zh-CN: 人工智能辅助编写的教学设计，已对照所引指南进行编辑审核。患者事实沿用 1.0.0 版从已发表报告中提取的内容，尚未对照原文全文核对。尚未经执业医师审核。
notes.en: AI-assisted teaching design with an editorial review against the cited guidance. The patient facts are those extracted from the published report for version 1.0.0; they have not yet been checked against the full source article. The case is not yet reviewed by a licensed clinician.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例回看，仅供临床教育，不用于个体诊疗或自行用药。病程和结果均来自原报告，不模拟未记录的生理变化。
disclaimer.en: Historical case review for clinical education, not for individual care or self-medication. The course and results come from the report; unrecorded physiological changes are not simulated.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 在曾按“尤文肉瘤”治疗的儿童中，从发热、双腿疼痛、面色苍白、皮肤出血点、肝脾肿大、以淋巴细胞为主的白细胞升高和血小板减少识别骨髓浸润，重新审视最初的诊断，而不是锚定于旧标签。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise marrow infiltration in a child previously treated for “Ewing sarcoma” — fever, pain in both legs, pallor, petechiae, an enlarged liver and spleen, a raised white count of mostly lymphocytes and low platelets — and re-examine the original diagnosis instead of anchoring on it.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 在中性粒细胞计数明确之前，把可疑急性白血病患儿的发热按发热伴中性粒细胞减少处理：先送血培养，再尽快按国际儿童发热伴中性粒细胞减少指南（2023年更新）对高危患儿的推荐，静脉用抗假单胞菌β-内酰胺类单药；血小板低时不用布洛芬，诊断标本取得前不用糖皮质激素。
learningOutcomes.en: Manage fever in a child with a suspected acute leukaemia as febrile neutropenia until the neutrophil count is known: blood cultures, then as soon as possible the antipseudomonal β-lactam monotherapy that the international paediatric fever-and-neutropenia guideline (2023 update) recommends for high-risk febrile neutropenia — no ibuprofen with a low platelet count and no corticosteroid before the diagnostic samples.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 安全处理不可信的检验值：识别写作7.1 g/L的血红蛋白与生命不相容、可能是单位或录入错误，输红细胞前复查血常规，再按实测值和BSH 2016儿童阈值（病情稳定者70 g/L）决定，既不照此数值处置，也不擅自改写。
learningOutcomes.en: Handle an implausible laboratory value safely: recognise a haemoglobin written as 7.1 g/L as incompatible with life and probably a unit or transcription error, repeat the count before any red-cell transfusion, and decide on the measured value against the BSH 2016 threshold for stable children (70 g/L) — never acting on the written figure or correcting it silently.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 说明为什么CD99和FLI-1蛋白不能区分尤文肉瘤和淋巴母细胞淋巴瘤（Folpe 2000；Lucas 2001），以及哪些检查能区分：TdT和B/T系标记，以及EWSR1重排或FET::ETS融合检测（WHO软组织和骨肿瘤分类第5版，2020）。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain why CD99 and FLI-1 protein cannot separate Ewing sarcoma from lymphoblastic lymphoma (Folpe 2000; Lucas 2001), and which tests do: TdT with B- and T-lineage markers, and testing for an EWSR1 rearrangement or FET::ETS fusion (WHO Classification of Soft Tissue and Bone Tumours, 5th edition, 2020).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 根据骨髓形态、流式细胞术（CD10、CD19、CD79a、HLA-DR、CD34）和TdT，按WHO造血与淋巴组织肿瘤分类第5版（2022）诊断B淋巴母细胞白血病/淋巴瘤，并按儿童急性淋巴细胞白血病式方案计划治疗（淋巴母细胞淋巴瘤同样如此，EURO-LB02，2017）：中枢神经系统评估、遗传学、MRD，并计入既往化疗的毒性。
learningOutcomes.en: Diagnose B-lymphoblastic leukaemia/lymphoma from the marrow morphology, flow cytometry (CD10, CD19, CD79a, HLA-DR, CD34) and TdT under the WHO 5th edition (2022), and plan ALL-type treatment — as for lymphoblastic lymphoma (EURO-LB02, 2017) — with CNS staging, genetics, MRD and the toxicity of the earlier chemotherapy taken into account.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 用SPIKES（Baile 2000）向家属说明诊断的改变——改变了什么、为什么、意味着什么——坦诚而不推测责任，并用6岁孩子能懂的话跟她本人说明。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain the changed diagnosis to the family with SPIKES (Baile 2000) — what changed, why and what it means — openly and without speculating about blame, and explain it to the girl herself in words a 6-year-old understands.

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 胳膊和腿反反复复疼了一年十个月，这两周又发烧了
chiefComplaint.en: Her arm and legs have hurt on and off for a year and ten months, and for two weeks she's had a fever again

triageNote.zh-CN: 6岁女孩，由家属陪同入院。曾在外院按骨肿瘤化疗6个疗程，评估为完全缓解；近2周发热、双下肢疼痛，现不能行走。入院体温38.6 ℃。
triageNote.en: 6-year-old girl admitted with a relative. Treated elsewhere for a bone tumour with six courses of chemotherapy and assessed as in complete remission; two weeks of fever and pain in both legs, now unable to walk. Temperature 38.6 °C on admission.

tags.en: After chemotherapy for a bone tumour

personality.zh-CN: 6岁女孩，发热两周、两条腿疼，现在走不了路，躺在病床上；有些害怕，只用几个字回答自己哪里疼、能不能走，其余由家属回答。
personality.en: A 6-year-old girl with two weeks of fever and pain in both legs who can no longer walk; lying in bed and a little frightened, she answers in a few words about where it hurts and whether she can walk, and leaves the rest to her relative.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 孩子说话很短、很口语；家属用日常话讲经过，不用医学术语，病名和治疗只复述医生当时说过的，药名和数字记不住就直说。
speechStyle.en: The girl speaks in very short, everyday phrases; her relative tells the story in plain words without medical terms, repeats only what the doctors said about the illness and its treatment, and says so when a drug name or a number is not known.

openingLine.en: (The girl) My legs hurt… I can't walk.

concerns.zh-CN: 化疗做完不是说缓解了吗？是不是那个骨头上的肿瘤又回来了？
concerns.en: They said the chemo had put it into remission — has that bone cancer come back?

actingNotes.zh-CN: 扮演者：孩子发热、两条腿疼，躺在床上，走不了路；只回答自己哪里疼、能不能走，每次几个字。家属回答其余病史：着急、心疼，只讲自己知道或听医生说过的事——一年十个月前左腿和右上臂疼、肿、动不了，外院说是尤文肉瘤，化疗六个疗程后说完全缓解。用了什么药、有没有放疗或手术、好了多久、这两周吃过什么药、过敏、疫苗、体重和家里人的病都说不上来，不要编。检查结果和诊断让医生说。确诊阶段家属会追问是不是还是原来的病、前面的化疗是不是白做了。
actingNotes.en: For the actor: the girl is feverish, both legs hurt, she lies in bed and cannot walk; she answers only where it hurts and whether she can walk, a few words at a time. The relative answers the rest: worried and protective, saying only what they know or have heard from the doctors — a year and ten months ago her left leg and right upper arm became painful, swollen and hard to move, the other hospital called it Ewing sarcoma, and after six courses of chemotherapy said it was in complete remission. The drugs, any radiotherapy or operation, how long she was well, what she has had in the last two weeks, allergies, vaccinations, her weight and the family's illnesses are not known — never invent them. Results and the diagnosis are for the doctors. In the diagnostic phase the relative asks whether it is still the same illness and whether the earlier chemotherapy was for nothing.

name.zh-CN: 何清和的家属（化名）

persona.zh-CN: 陪孩子住院的近亲属；具体是哪位亲属不清楚，不要另加设定。着急、心疼孩子，愿意配合；记得外院说过的病名和化疗疗程数，记不住药名和日期；只讲自己知道或听医生说过的事，不替医生下结论。
persona.en: The close relative staying with her; which relative is not known, so add nothing. Worried and protective but cooperative; remembers the diagnosis the other hospital gave and the number of chemotherapy courses, not the drug names or dates; says only what they know or have heard from the doctors and draws no medical conclusions.

label.zh-CN: 入院：发热两周、不能走路
label.en: Admission: two weeks of fever, unable to walk

description.zh-CN: 她曾在外院按骨肿瘤化疗，之后评估为完全缓解；这两周发热、两条腿疼，现在走不了路，今天住进儿科病房。向家属和孩子了解病情、给她查体、调阅外院病理报告、开出入院检查，并安排最初几小时的处置。
description.en: She was treated elsewhere with chemotherapy for a bone tumour and assessed afterwards as in complete remission; for two weeks she has had a fever and pain in both legs, she can no longer walk, and today she is admitted to the children's ward. Take the history from her relative and from her, examine her, read the outside pathology report, send the admission tests and set up the first hours of care.

label.en: Marrow results and the pathology review

description.zh-CN: 骨髓穿刺已经完成，骨髓形态、流式细胞术和对外院原骨活检的复核结果出来了（在住院第几天没有记录）。据此明确诊断、制定治疗计划，并与家属谈话。
description.en: The marrow aspirate has been done, and the marrow morphology, the flow cytometry and the review of the original outside biopsy are back (the day of the admission is not recorded). Establish the diagnosis from them, plan treatment and talk with the family.

text.zh-CN: 报告的诊断：最初的骨病变是B淋巴母细胞淋巴瘤，被误诊为尤文肉瘤；这次复发时已有白血病样的广泛骨髓受累。病理复核认为结果支持B淋巴母细胞肿瘤。治疗改为儿童淋巴母细胞方案：第8天外周血幼稚细胞为0，第33天评估为完全缓解，报告发表时正在维持治疗。本病例没有记录所用药物和剂量、中枢神经系统状态、遗传学结果、微小残留病、是否做过EWSR1检测，也没有记录维持治疗以后的长期结局。
text.en: The report's diagnosis: the original bone lesion was a B-lymphoblastic lymphoma misdiagnosed as Ewing sarcoma, and at this recurrence the marrow was extensively involved, as in leukaemia. The pathology review concluded that the findings supported a B-lymphoblastic neoplasm. Treatment was changed to a paediatric lymphoblastic regimen: on day 8 no immature cells were seen in the peripheral blood, on day 33 she was assessed as in complete remission, and at publication she was on maintenance treatment. This case does not record the drugs and doses, her CNS status, the genetics, minimal residual disease, whether EWSR1 testing was done, or the long-term outcome after maintenance.

harm.zh-CN: 血小板20×10⁹/L、身上已有出血点时，非甾体抗炎药会抑制血小板功能、加重出血风险；肿瘤溶解风险期还可能损伤肾脏。退热止痛用对乙酰氨基酚。
harm.en: With platelets of 20 × 10⁹/L and petechiae, an NSAID impairs platelet function and adds to the bleeding risk, and it can harm the kidneys while tumour lysis is a risk. Use paracetamol for fever and pain.

response.zh-CN: 已给布洛芬。本病例没有记录用过非甾体抗炎药；不模拟其后果。
response.en: Ibuprofen given. This case does not record any NSAID; it does not simulate the consequences.

name.zh-CN: 不含钾的静脉水化（预防肿瘤溶解）
name.en: Potassium-free IV hydration to prevent tumour lysis

dose.zh-CN: 不含钾的晶体液，约3 L/m²/天（约为维持量的2倍），按出入量和电解质调整，记录出入量。
dose.en: A potassium-free crystalloid at about 3 L/m²/day (roughly twice maintenance), adjusted to fluid balance and electrolytes, with an input–output chart.

response.zh-CN: 已开始不含钾的静脉水化并记录出入量。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Potassium-free IV hydration is running with a fluid-balance chart. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 别嘌醇

dose.zh-CN: 口服，按体重给药（儿童常用约10 mg/kg/天，分2–3次）；剂量由专科团队按方案确定。
dose.en: By mouth, weight-based (children commonly about 10 mg/kg/day in 2–3 divided doses); the specialist team sets the dose by protocol.

response.zh-CN: 已开始别嘌醇。本病例没有记录是否用过别嘌醇；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Allopurinol started. This case does not record whether allopurinol was given; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 按记录的血红蛋白7.1 g/L输注红细胞
name.en: Red-cell transfusion for the recorded haemoglobin of 7.1 g/L

dose.zh-CN: 红细胞按体重静脉输注（常用10–15 mL/kg）。
dose.en: Red cells IV by weight (commonly 10–15 mL/kg).

harm.zh-CN: 写作7.1 g/L的血红蛋白与生命不相容，很可能是单位或录入错误（7.1 g/dL即71 g/L）。照这个数值输血，或者悄悄把它改成71再输，都是在没有核实的数据上做决定。先复查血常规，再按实测血红蛋白和临床情况决定（BSH 2016：病情稳定的儿童阈值为70 g/L）。
harm.en: A haemoglobin written as 7.1 g/L would not be compatible with life; it is probably a unit or transcription error (7.1 g/dL is 71 g/L). Transfusing on it — or quietly 'correcting' it to 71 and transfusing — acts on an unverified number. Repeat the count, then decide on the measured haemoglobin and her clinical state (BSH 2016: 70 g/L for stable children).

response.zh-CN: 已输注红细胞。本病例没有记录输过红细胞；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Red cells given. This case does not record a red-cell transfusion; it does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 输注血小板（腰椎穿刺前）
name.en: Platelet transfusion before the lumbar puncture

dose.zh-CN: 按体重输注血小板（常用10–15 mL/kg，体重较大的儿童用1个成人治疗量），输后复查计数。
dose.en: Platelets by weight (commonly 10–15 mL/kg, or one adult dose for a larger child), with a count after the transfusion.

response.zh-CN: 已输注血小板。本病例没有记录输过血小板，也没有输后计数；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Platelets given. This case does not record a platelet transfusion or a post-transfusion count; it does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 立即用地塞米松退热止痛
name.en: Dexamethasone now for the fever and leg pain

dose.zh-CN: 地塞米松按体重静脉或口服。
dose.en: Dexamethasone IV or by mouth, by weight.

harm.zh-CN: 在骨髓、流式细胞术和脑脊液标本取得之前用糖皮质激素，会让淋巴母细胞迅速溶解：诊断和危险度分组（包括激素反应）可能无法完成，还可能诱发肿瘤溶解综合征；英国儿童癌症与白血病组（CCLG，2026）要求怀疑白血病或淋巴瘤时转诊前不用糖皮质激素。激素属于确诊后的诱导方案；现在退热止痛用对乙酰氨基酚。
harm.en: A corticosteroid before the marrow, flow cytometry and CSF samples lyses lymphoblasts quickly: the diagnosis and the risk grouping (including the steroid response) may become impossible to complete, and tumour lysis can follow; the Children's Cancer and Leukaemia Group says no corticosteroid before referral when leukaemia or lymphoma is possible (CCLG, 2026). The steroid belongs to the induction protocol after the diagnosis; for fever and pain now, use paracetamol.

response.zh-CN: 已给地塞米松。本病例没有记录这一步；不模拟其后果。
response.en: Dexamethasone given. This case does not record this step; it does not simulate the consequences.

name.zh-CN: 按复发尤文肉瘤开始二线化疗（异环磷酰胺加依托泊苷）
name.en: Second-line chemotherapy for relapsed Ewing sarcoma (ifosfamide with etoposide)

dose.zh-CN: 按复发尤文肉瘤方案给药，剂量按体表面积计算。
dose.en: By a relapsed Ewing sarcoma protocol, dosed by body surface area.

harm.zh-CN: 原来的“尤文肉瘤”从未得到确证：CD99和FLI-1阳性在淋巴母细胞淋巴瘤中同样常见，这个肿瘤还是CD3阳性，没有TdT和EWSR1检测的记录，而WHO 2020分类以FET::ETS融合定义尤文肉瘤。在骨髓和病理复核之前按旧标签给肉瘤化疗，会在一个发热、血小板20×10⁹/L的孩子身上加重骨髓抑制和感染风险，同时耽误真正疾病的治疗。
harm.en: The original “Ewing sarcoma” was never proven: CD99 and FLI-1 positivity is common in lymphoblastic lymphoma too, the tumour was CD3 positive, no TdT or EWSR1 test is recorded, and the WHO 2020 classification defines Ewing sarcoma by a FET::ETS fusion. Sarcoma chemotherapy on the old label, before the marrow and a pathology review, deepens marrow suppression and infection risk in a febrile child with platelets of 20 × 10⁹/L and delays treatment of the real disease.

response.zh-CN: 已开始尤文肉瘤二线化疗。本病例没有记录这一步；不模拟其后果。
response.en: Second-line Ewing chemotherapy started. This case does not record this step; it does not simulate the consequences.

name.zh-CN: 请病理科复核外院原骨活检（补做TdT、B/T系标记和EWSR1检测）
name.en: Ask pathology to review the outside bone biopsy with TdT, B- and T-cell markers and EWSR1 testing

dose.zh-CN: 向外院借阅原骨活检切片和蜡块，请儿童或骨肿瘤病理医生复核：补做TdT、CD79a/PAX5、CD19、CD10、CD3、CD45等，并做EWSR1分离探针FISH或融合检测。
dose.en: Borrow the original biopsy slides and blocks from the other hospital and have a paediatric or bone-tumour pathologist review them, adding TdT, CD79a/PAX5, CD19, CD10, CD3 and CD45, with EWSR1 break-apart FISH or fusion testing.

response.zh-CN: 已申请病理复核。原报告记录了对外院原骨活检的复核，结果见确诊阶段的病理复核记录；是否做过EWSR1检测没有记录。
response.en: The pathology review is requested. The report records a review of the original outside biopsy; its result is in the pathology review record of the diagnostic phase. Whether EWSR1 testing was done is not recorded.

name.zh-CN: 当天请儿童血液肿瘤科会诊

dose.zh-CN: 电话联系并请当天会诊，交代既往按骨肿瘤化疗的经过和今天的发现。
dose.en: Phone and ask for a same-day consultation, handing over the earlier treatment for a bone tumour and today's findings.

response.zh-CN: 已请儿童血液肿瘤科今天会诊。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The paediatric haematology-oncology team is asked to see her today. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 诊断性腰椎穿刺并鞘内注射首剂化疗
name.en: Diagnostic lumbar puncture with the first intrathecal dose

dose.zh-CN: 由有经验的医生在镇静下操作，先把血小板升到方案要求的水平；送脑脊液细胞计数、蛋白和离心涂片找原始细胞，同时按方案鞘内注射。
dose.en: By an experienced operator under sedation, once platelets are raised to the protocol's threshold; CSF for cell count, protein and a cytospin for blasts, with the protocol's first intrathecal dose.

harm.zh-CN: 诊断性腰穿应在确诊之后、血小板升高之后，由有经验的医生与首剂鞘内化疗一起做：外周血里有原始细胞时，穿刺损伤会把原始细胞带入脑脊液，使预后变差（Gajjar 2000）；血小板20×10⁹/L时还有椎管内出血的风险。
harm.en: The diagnostic lumbar puncture belongs after the diagnosis and after the platelets have been raised, done by an experienced operator with the first intrathecal dose: a traumatic tap with blasts in the blood can carry them into the CSF and worsens the outcome (Gajjar 2000), and with platelets of 20 × 10⁹/L there is a risk of bleeding into the spinal canal.

response.zh-CN: 已完成腰椎穿刺和鞘内注射。本病例没有记录脑脊液结果和鞘内用药；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The lumbar puncture and the intrathecal dose are done. This case does not record a CSF result or the intrathecal drug; it does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 按儿童急性淋巴细胞白血病方案开始诱导治疗
name.en: Start induction on a paediatric acute lymphoblastic leukaemia protocol

dose.zh-CN: 按现行儿童急性淋巴细胞白血病方案（例如BFM类方案）的诱导用药，剂量按体表面积；开始前评估肿瘤溶解风险、查心脏功能，并核对既往化疗中蒽环类药物的累积剂量。
dose.en: The induction of a current paediatric ALL protocol (a BFM-type protocol, for example), dosed by body surface area, after the tumour-lysis assessment, a cardiac assessment and a check of the cumulative anthracycline dose of the earlier chemotherapy.

harm.zh-CN: 确诊前开始化疗（诱导方案含糖皮质激素，而英国儿童癌症与白血病组CCLG 2026要求怀疑白血病或淋巴瘤时转诊前不用激素），会让骨髓、流式细胞术和脑脊液的诊断与危险度分组无法完成，并可能诱发肿瘤溶解。先取得诊断标本、明确诊断，再按方案开始。
harm.en: Chemotherapy before the diagnosis — the induction includes a corticosteroid, which the Children's Cancer and Leukaemia Group says must not be given before referral when leukaemia or lymphoma is possible (CCLG, 2026) — can leave the marrow, flow cytometry and CSF diagnosis and the risk grouping incomplete, and can precipitate tumour lysis. Take the diagnostic samples and make the diagnosis first, then start the protocol.

response.zh-CN: 已按儿童急性淋巴细胞白血病方案开始诱导。原报告记录治疗改为儿童淋巴母细胞方案；本病例不模拟治疗反应。
response.en: Induction on a paediatric ALL protocol is started. The report records that treatment was changed to a paediatric lymphoblastic regimen; the case does not simulate the response.

name.zh-CN: 与家属谈话（主治医生、血液肿瘤科医生和护士参加）
name.en: Meet the family with the attending, the haemato-oncologist and a nurse

dose.zh-CN: 安静的房间，预留足够时间：说明诊断为什么改变、新的治疗计划和不确定之处，回答提问，约好下次谈话并记录；再用孩子能懂的话单独跟她说明。
dose.en: A quiet room and enough time: explain why the diagnosis has changed, the new plan and what is uncertain, answer questions, agree when to talk again and record it; then explain things to her separately in words she understands.

response.zh-CN: 家属谈话已进行。本病例没有记录谈话内容；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The family meeting is held. This case does not record what was said; it does not simulate its effect.

title.zh-CN: 问清这次和最初的病情
title.en: Find out about this illness and the first one

hint.zh-CN: 这次有哪些症状、多久了、还能不能走？最初是怎么起病的，外院诊断的依据是什么，治疗了多少、效果怎样？
hint.en: What are her symptoms this time, for how long, and can she walk? How did the first illness begin, what was the other hospital's diagnosis based on, and what treatment did she have, with what result?

guidance.zh-CN: 到床旁，向家属和孩子了解病史。
guidance.en: Go to the bedside and take the history from her relative and from her.

hint.zh-CN: 一个发热、走不了路的孩子，床旁哪些体征最要紧，为什么？体温、面色、皮肤、肝脾和行走都查了吗？
hint.en: In a feverish child who can no longer walk, which bedside findings matter most, and why? Have you checked her temperature, colour, skin, liver, spleen and walking?

title.zh-CN: 读懂最初的结果，落实最初几小时的处置
title.en: Read the first results and act in the first hours

hint.zh-CN: 外院的病理到底证明了什么、没有证明什么？这个血象怎么解释？在骨髓结果出来之前，接下来几小时里什么最危险，哪些看似合理的做法反而会让情况更糟？
hint.en: What did the outside pathology prove, and what did it not? What explains this blood count? Before the marrow result, what is most dangerous in the next hours, and which reasonable-looking steps would make things worse?

guidance.zh-CN: 调阅外院骨活检报告，开出入院检查并调阅血常规；在会诊板作答决策1和决策2，并在床旁落实决策2选定的处置。
guidance.en: Read the outside biopsy report, send the admission tests and read the blood count; answer decisions 1 and 2 on the case board and carry out the decision 2 plan at the bedside.

hint.zh-CN: 哪些标记能确定细胞系别，哪些标记说明细胞有多幼稚？最初的骨活检和现在的骨髓说的是同一种病吗？
hint.en: Which markers set the lineage, and which tell you how immature the cells are? Do the original biopsy and today's marrow describe the same disease?

guidance.zh-CN: 调阅骨髓形态、流式细胞术和病理复核结果，在会诊板作答决策3。
guidance.en: Read the marrow morphology, the flow cytometry and the pathology review, then answer decision 3 on the case board.

title.zh-CN: 制定治疗计划，并与家属谈话
title.en: Plan treatment and talk with the family

hint.zh-CN: 这种病该用什么方案治？开始腰穿和化疗之前，还需要知道什么、先做什么才安全？家属听到你现在要说的话，会怎样理解？
hint.en: Which protocol treats this disease? What do you still need to know or do before a safe lumbar puncture and chemotherapy? How will the family take what you now have to tell them?

guidance.zh-CN: 在会诊板作答决策4和决策5，并与家属谈话。
guidance.en: Answer decisions 4 and 5 on the case board and hold the family meeting.

title.zh-CN: 对照原报告的治疗与转归
title.en: Compare your plan with the reported course

hint.zh-CN: 原报告最后是怎么治的？早期的治疗反应能说明什么，又不能说明什么？
hint.en: How did the report's team treat her in the end? What can an early treatment response tell you, and what can it not?

guidance.zh-CN: 在病历终端调阅原报告记录的诊断、治疗与转归。
guidance.en: Read the reported diagnosis, treatment and outcome at a records terminal.

prompt.zh-CN: 6岁女孩，一年十个月前左下肢和右上臂疼痛，外院骨活检为小圆细胞肿瘤（CD99、FLI-1、CD3阳性，CD20阴性，没有TdT记录），诊断为尤文肉瘤，化疗6个疗程后评估为完全缓解。现发热2周、双下肢疼痛、不能行走；体温38.6 ℃，贫血貌，散在出血点，肝肋下3 cm，脾肋下2.5 cm；白细胞42.38×10⁹/L、淋巴细胞91%，血小板20×10⁹/L，血红蛋白记为7.1 g/L。现在最可能是什么？下一步怎么做诊断？
prompt.en: A 6-year-old girl had pain in the left leg and right upper arm a year and ten months ago; a small round cell tumour on the outside bone biopsy (CD99, FLI-1 and CD3 positive, CD20 negative, no TdT recorded) was diagnosed as Ewing sarcoma, and after six courses of chemotherapy she was assessed as in complete remission. Now: two weeks of fever and pain in both legs, unable to walk; temperature 38.6 °C, pallor, scattered petechiae, liver 3 cm and spleen 2.5 cm below the costal margins; white cells 42.38 × 10⁹/L with 91 % lymphocytes, platelets 20 × 10⁹/L, haemoglobin written as 7.1 g/L. What is most likely now, and what is the next diagnostic step?

need.zh-CN: 先问清这次和最初的病史（包括外院的诊断和治疗），查体（体温、面色、皮肤、肝脾），再调阅外院骨活检报告和入院血常规。
need.en: First take the history of this illness and of the first one (including the other hospital's diagnosis and treatment), examine her (temperature, colour, skin, liver and spleen), and read the outside biopsy report and the admission blood count.

text.zh-CN: 淋巴母细胞白血病或淋巴瘤正在浸润骨髓，最初的肿瘤也可能就是它：现在做骨髓穿刺和流式细胞术，并复核原骨活检，补做TdT、系别标记和EWSR1检测
text.en: A lymphoblastic leukaemia or lymphoma now in her marrow, which the first tumour may also have been: marrow aspirate with flow cytometry now, and a review of the original biopsy with TdT, lineage markers and EWSR1 testing

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。发热、双腿疼痛、面色苍白、出血点、肝脾肿大、以淋巴细胞为主的白细胞升高和血小板20×10⁹/L，提示骨髓被浸润。外院的“尤文肉瘤”从未得到确证：CD99和FLI-1蛋白在淋巴母细胞淋巴瘤中同样表达（Folpe 2000；Lucas 2001），这个肿瘤还是CD3阳性、没有TdT记录，而WHO软组织和骨肿瘤分类（2020）以FET::ETS融合定义尤文肉瘤，这项检测也没有记录。所以要同时取骨髓、复核原活检。
feedback.en: Right. Fever, pain in both legs, pallor, petechiae, an enlarged liver and spleen, a lymphocyte-predominant leucocytosis and platelets of 20 × 10⁹/L point to marrow infiltration. The outside “Ewing sarcoma” was never proven: CD99 and FLI-1 protein are also expressed by lymphoblastic lymphoma (Folpe 2000; Lucas 2001), the tumour was CD3 positive with no TdT recorded, and the WHO Classification of Soft Tissue and Bone Tumours (2020) defines Ewing sarcoma by a FET::ETS fusion, for which no test is recorded. So sample the marrow and have the original biopsy reviewed together.

text.zh-CN: 尤文肉瘤复发并转移到骨髓：小圆细胞肿瘤、CD99和FLI-1阳性早已定论，先做PET-CT和双侧骨髓活检重新分期，再按复发尤文肉瘤安排二线化疗
text.en: Ewing sarcoma relapsing with marrow metastases, since a CD99- and FLI-1-positive small round cell tumour settled the diagnosis: restage with PET-CT and bilateral marrow trephines, then plan second-line Ewing chemotherapy

feedback.zh-CN: 尤文肉瘤可以转移到骨髓，但骨髓转移造成的是血细胞减少，不会出现白细胞42.38×10⁹/L、91%是淋巴细胞的血象。这个诊断本身也不牢靠：CD99和FLI-1在淋巴母细胞淋巴瘤中同样阳性（Folpe 2000），肿瘤还是CD3阳性，没有TdT和EWSR1检测的记录，而WHO 2020分类以FET::ETS融合定义尤文肉瘤。在骨髓和病理复核之前就重新分期、准备肉瘤二线化疗，是在治疗一个没有被证实的标签。
feedback.en: Ewing sarcoma can spread to the marrow, but marrow metastases cause low counts, not a white count of 42.38 × 10⁹/L made up of 91 % lymphocytes. The diagnosis itself was never secure: CD99 and FLI-1 are also positive in lymphoblastic lymphoma (Folpe 2000), the tumour was CD3 positive, no TdT or EWSR1 test is recorded, and the WHO 2020 classification defines Ewing sarcoma by a FET::ETS fusion. Restaging and second-line sarcoma chemotherapy before the marrow and a pathology review would treat an unproven label.

text.zh-CN: 可能是以前的化疗引起的治疗相关性急性白血病，尤文肉瘤仍在缓解中：做骨髓穿刺，查KMT2A和髓系相关的细胞遗传学改变；原来的骨活检不需要复核
text.en: A therapy-related acute leukaemia, which the earlier chemotherapy may have caused, with the Ewing sarcoma still in remission: marrow aspirate with cytogenetics for KMT2A and myeloid changes; the original biopsy needs no review

feedback.zh-CN: 治疗尤文肉瘤常用的拓扑异构酶Ⅱ抑制剂和烷化剂确实会引起治疗相关性白血病，但她用过哪些药没有记录。更关键的是，这个选项不再追问原诊断：一个CD3阳性、没做TdT的小圆细胞肿瘤，既可以是尤文肉瘤，也可以是淋巴母细胞淋巴瘤，因为CD99和FLI-1是两者共有的（Folpe 2000；Lucas 2001）。取骨髓是对的，拒绝复核原活检是错的。
feedback.en: Therapy-related leukaemia is a real risk after the topoisomerase II inhibitors and alkylating agents used for Ewing sarcoma, but which drugs she received is not recorded. More importantly, this option stops questioning the first diagnosis: a CD3-positive small round cell tumour with no TdT stain fits a lymphoblastic lymphoma as well as Ewing sarcoma, because CD99 and FLI-1 are shared (Folpe 2000; Lucas 2001). The marrow is right; refusing to review the biopsy is not.

text.zh-CN: 化疗后孩子的发热性感染，淋巴细胞增多和血小板减少也可能是感染引起的：送血培养、用抗生素，一周后复查血常规，再决定要不要做骨髓检查
text.en: A febrile infection after chemotherapy, which may also explain a reactive lymphocytosis and the low platelets: blood cultures and antibiotics, then repeat the count in a week before deciding on a marrow test

feedback.zh-CN: 感染能解释发热，却解释不了肝脾肿大加上白细胞42.38×10⁹/L、淋巴细胞91%和血小板20×10⁹/L，何况她得过一个诊断并不牢靠的小圆细胞肿瘤（WHO 2020分类以FET::ETS融合定义尤文肉瘤）。她正在发热、血小板很低，等一周再复查只会耽误诊断。血培养和抗生素要给，骨髓也要现在做。
feedback.en: Infection may explain the fever, but not an enlarged liver and spleen with a white count of 42.38 × 10⁹/L, 91 % lymphocytes and platelets of 20 × 10⁹/L, in a child whose small round cell tumour was never securely diagnosed (the WHO 2020 classification defines Ewing sarcoma by a FET::ETS fusion). Waiting a week while she is febrile with very low platelets only delays the diagnosis: give the cultures and antibiotics, and sample the marrow now.

prompt.zh-CN: 她发热38.6 ℃，血小板20×10⁹/L、身上有出血点，中性粒细胞计数没有记录，血红蛋白记为7.1 g/L，骨髓还没有取。最初几小时里你会做哪些？（选出所有应做的）
prompt.en: She is febrile at 38.6 °C, her platelets are 20 × 10⁹/L with petechiae, her neutrophil count is not recorded, her haemoglobin is written as 7.1 g/L, and the marrow has not yet been sampled. Which of these do you do in the first hours? (Choose all that apply.)

text.zh-CN: 先送血培养，不等中性粒细胞结果，尽快静脉用抗假单胞菌β-内酰胺类抗生素
text.en: Blood cultures, then an antipseudomonal β-lactam IV as soon as possible, without waiting for the neutrophil count

feedback.zh-CN: 应该做。她的中性粒细胞计数没有记录，骨髓很可能已被浸润，所以在计数明确之前按高危发热伴中性粒细胞减少处理：先留血培养，再尽快用抗假单胞菌β-内酰胺类、第四代头孢菌素或碳青霉烯类单药经验治疗（国际儿童发热伴中性粒细胞减少指南，J Clin Oncol 2023年更新）。
feedback.en: Yes. Her neutrophil count is not recorded and her marrow is probably infiltrated, so manage the fever as high-risk febrile neutropenia until the count is known: cultures first, then empirical monotherapy with an antipseudomonal β-lactam, a fourth-generation cephalosporin or a carbapenem as soon as possible (international paediatric fever-and-neutropenia guideline, J Clin Oncol 2023 update).

text.zh-CN: 复查血常规和血涂片，先核实血红蛋白，再决定要不要输红细胞
text.en: Repeat the full blood count and film to confirm the haemoglobin before deciding on red cells

feedback.zh-CN: 应该做。写作7.1 g/L的血红蛋白与生命不相容，很可能是单位或录入错误（7.1 g/dL即71 g/L）。输血前先复查，再按实测值决定：BSH 2016建议病情稳定的儿童以70 g/L为输注阈值；人工分类还能给出中性粒细胞计数。
feedback.en: Yes. A haemoglobin written as 7.1 g/L is incompatible with life and is probably a unit or transcription error (7.1 g/dL is 71 g/L). Re-measure it before any transfusion and decide on the measured value — BSH 2016 suggests a threshold of 70 g/L for stable children — and the manual differential gives you the neutrophil count.

text.zh-CN: 开始不含钾的静脉水化和别嘌醇，并查电解质、尿酸、磷、钙、肌酐和乳酸脱氢酶
text.en: Potassium-free IV fluids and allopurinol, with electrolytes, urate, phosphate, calcium, creatinine and LDH

feedback.zh-CN: 应该做。可能的急性淋巴细胞白血病、白细胞42.38×10⁹/L，乳酸脱氢酶和尿酸、钾、磷都不知道，至少属于肿瘤溶解中危（TLS专家共识，Cairo 2010）：任何细胞毒治疗之前先水化、用别嘌醇，并把这些指标查清楚。
feedback.en: Yes. A probable acute lymphoblastic leukaemia with a white count of 42.38 × 10⁹/L, and an unknown LDH, urate, potassium and phosphate, is at least intermediate risk for tumour lysis (TLS expert panel, Cairo 2010): hydrate, give allopurinol and measure them before any cytotoxic treatment.

text.zh-CN: 今晚用地塞米松压住发热和两条腿的疼，明天再做骨髓穿刺
text.en: Dexamethasone tonight to settle her fever and the pain in both legs before the marrow tomorrow

feedback.zh-CN: 不应做。在骨髓、流式细胞术和脑脊液标本取得之前用糖皮质激素，会溶解淋巴母细胞，使诊断和危险度分组难以完成，还可能诱发肿瘤溶解，所以英国儿童癌症与白血病组（CCLG，2026）要求怀疑白血病或淋巴瘤时转诊前不用糖皮质激素；激素属于确诊后的诱导方案。发热和疼痛用对乙酰氨基酚，血小板20×10⁹/L时不用非甾体抗炎药。
feedback.en: No. A corticosteroid before the marrow, flow cytometry and CSF samples can lyse lymphoblasts, cloud the diagnosis and the risk group and precipitate tumour lysis, which is why the Children's Cancer and Leukaemia Group says no corticosteroid before referral when leukaemia or lymphoma is possible (CCLG, 2026); the steroid belongs to induction once the diagnosis is made. Treat the fever and pain with paracetamol, and avoid NSAIDs with platelets of 20 × 10⁹/L.

text.zh-CN: 按记录的7.1 g/L立即输注红细胞，血红蛋白这么低，等不及复查
text.en: Red cells now for the recorded haemoglobin of 7.1 g/L, far too low to wait for a repeat count

feedback.zh-CN: 不应做。不要按一个不可能成立的数值输血，也不要悄悄把它“改正”成71 g/L：先复查。复查确实低时，再按实测血红蛋白和临床情况输注（BSH 2016：病情稳定的儿童以70 g/L为阈值）。
feedback.en: No. Do not transfuse on a value that cannot be true, and do not quietly “correct” it to 71 g/L: re-measure it. If the repeat confirms a low value, transfuse on the measured haemoglobin and her clinical state (BSH 2016: 70 g/L for stable children).

prompt.zh-CN: 骨髓：原始及幼稚淋巴细胞84.5%。流式细胞术：表达CD10、CD19、CD79a、HLA-DR和CD34。外院原骨活检和本次骨髓的复核：TdT阳性，CD99阳性，CD79部分阳性。怎样判断她现在的病和最初的骨肿瘤？
prompt.en: Marrow: lymphoblasts and immature lymphocytes 84.5 %. Flow cytometry: CD10, CD19, CD79a, HLA-DR and CD34 expressed. Review of the original bone biopsy and the new marrow: TdT positive, CD99 positive, CD79 partly positive. How do you now classify her disease and the original bone tumour?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅骨髓形态、流式细胞术和病理复核结果。
need.en: First read the marrow morphology, the flow cytometry and the pathology review.

text.zh-CN: 原骨肿瘤就是B淋巴母细胞淋巴瘤，因淋巴母细胞也表达CD99和FLI-1被误作尤文肉瘤；现在骨髓受累超过25%，按B淋巴母细胞白血病处理
text.en: The original tumour was a B-lymphoblastic lymphoma taken for Ewing sarcoma, because lymphoblasts also express CD99 and FLI-1; with marrow involvement now above 25 % it is managed as B-lymphoblastic leukaemia

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。TdT标记淋巴母细胞，CD19、CD79a和CD10确定B系（WHO造血与淋巴组织肿瘤分类第5版，2022）；对原骨活检的复核同样记录到TdT阳性，把首发的骨肿瘤与现在这个淋巴母细胞肿瘤联系在一起，而CD99和FLI-1区分不了它和尤文肉瘤（Folpe 2000；Lucas 2001）。按惯例骨髓受累超过25%即称白血病，而淋巴母细胞淋巴瘤本来也用急性淋巴细胞白血病式方案治疗（EURO-LB02，Landmann 2017）。
feedback.en: Right. TdT marks lymphoblasts, and CD19, CD79a and CD10 assign B lineage (WHO Classification of Haematolymphoid Tumours, 5th edition, 2022); TdT recorded on review of the original biopsy as well ties the first tumour to the same lymphoblastic neoplasm, which CD99 and FLI-1 cannot separate from Ewing sarcoma (Folpe 2000; Lucas 2001). By convention, marrow involvement of more than 25 % is called leukaemia, and lymphoblastic lymphoma is treated with ALL-type protocols anyway (EURO-LB02, Landmann 2017).

text.zh-CN: 两种病同时存在：尤文肉瘤仍在缓解，另有以前的化疗引起的治疗相关性B淋巴母细胞白血病，所以白血病治疗期间仍要继续按尤文肉瘤随访复查
text.en: Two separate diseases: Ewing sarcoma still in remission and a new therapy-related B-lymphoblastic leukaemia caused by the earlier chemotherapy, so sarcoma follow-up continues alongside leukaemia treatment

feedback.zh-CN: 治疗相关性白血病确实可能发生，但它解释不了复核首次发病的诊断性骨活检时记录到的TdT阳性。一种被误认作尤文肉瘤的淋巴母细胞肿瘤，就能同时解释首发的骨病变和现在的骨髓；一个TdT阳性的肿瘤，只有证实存在FET::ETS融合（WHO 2020分类定义尤文肉瘤的改变）才能维持尤文肉瘤的诊断，而这样的检测没有任何记录。
feedback.en: A therapy-related leukaemia is possible, but it cannot explain the TdT positivity recorded on review of the diagnostic biopsy of the first illness. One lymphoblastic neoplasm misread as Ewing sarcoma explains both the first bone lesion and today's marrow; in a tumour that stains for TdT, only a demonstrated FET::ETS fusion — the alteration that defines Ewing sarcoma in the WHO 2020 classification — could keep the Ewing diagnosis, and no such test is recorded.

text.zh-CN: B系加T系的混合表型急性白血病：原肿瘤CD3阳性，现在骨髓原始细胞表达B系标记，所以需要按混合表型急性白血病的方案治疗
text.en: A mixed-phenotype acute leukaemia of B and T lineage: the original tumour was CD3 positive and the marrow blasts express B-lineage markers, so it needs a mixed-phenotype protocol

feedback.zh-CN: 混合表型急性白血病要求原始细胞本身符合两个系别的定系标准（同一群原始细胞或两群不同的原始细胞均可），T系需要原始细胞胞质（或膜）CD3阳性（WHO第5版，2022）。组织切片上的CD3免疫组化也会染到肿瘤周围的反应性T细胞，旧报告的CD3阳性是不是在肿瘤细胞上并没有记录；现在流式细胞术记录的是B系标记（CD19、CD79a、CD10）和前体标记（CD34、HLA-DR），没有记录T系标记。CD3这一点应作为问题交给病理医生，而不是当成第二个系别。
feedback.en: Mixed-phenotype acute leukaemia needs blasts that meet the lineage-defining criteria of two lineages — in one blast population or in two separate ones — and for T lineage that means cytoplasmic (or surface) CD3 on the blasts themselves (WHO 5th edition, 2022). A CD3 immunostain in a tissue section also stains the reactive T cells around a tumour, and whether the old CD3 positivity was in the tumour cells is not recorded; the flow cytometry now records B-lineage (CD19, CD79a, CD10) and precursor (CD34, HLA-DR) markers and no T-cell markers. Treat the CD3 result as a question for the pathologist, not as a second lineage.

text.zh-CN: 尤文肉瘤在骨髓中复发，肿瘤细胞只是异常表达了CD10、CD19和CD79a；只要骨髓的EWSR1检测证实，尤文肉瘤二线化疗仍然是对的选择
text.en: Ewing sarcoma relapsing in the marrow with tumour cells aberrantly expressing CD10, CD19 and CD79a; second-line Ewing chemotherapy is still right once EWSR1 testing of the marrow confirms it

feedback.zh-CN: TdT加上B系标记CD19、CD79a和CD10，定义的是B淋巴母细胞肿瘤；CD99是两者共有的，正因为如此，要用CD99加TdT和淋巴细胞标记的组合来区分尤文肉瘤和淋巴母细胞淋巴瘤（Lucas 2001）。为了给肉瘤化疗找依据而等EWSR1结果，只会推迟骨髓已经显示需要的急性淋巴细胞白血病式治疗；原蜡块的EWSR1检测只用来了结旧的疑问。
feedback.en: TdT with the B-lineage markers CD19, CD79a and CD10 defines a B-lymphoblastic neoplasm; CD99 is shared, which is exactly why a panel of CD99 with TdT and lymphoid markers is used to separate Ewing sarcoma from lymphoblastic lymphoma (Lucas 2001). Waiting for an EWSR1 result to justify sarcoma chemotherapy only delays the ALL-type treatment the marrow already calls for; EWSR1 testing of the old block serves to close the old question.

prompt.zh-CN: 诊断已改为B淋巴母细胞白血病/淋巴瘤。她此前按“尤文肉瘤”接受过6个疗程化疗（药物和剂量没有记录），血小板20×10⁹/L，中枢神经系统状态和遗传学结果都还不知道。治疗计划是什么？
prompt.en: The diagnosis is now B-lymphoblastic leukaemia/lymphoma. She has had six courses of chemotherapy for “Ewing sarcoma” (drugs and doses not recorded), her platelets are 20 × 10⁹/L, and her CNS status and genetics are not yet known. What is the treatment plan?

need.zh-CN: 先完成决策3：判断骨髓和病理结果说明了什么。
need.en: First answer decision 3: what the marrow and pathology results show.

text.zh-CN: 在血液肿瘤中心按现行儿童急淋方案诱导：输血小板后腰穿并首剂鞘注，查遗传学，按微小残留病分层，先核对既往蒽环类剂量并查心脏超声
text.en: A current paediatric ALL protocol at a haemato-oncology centre: lumbar puncture with the first intrathecal dose after platelets, genetics, MRD-guided risk, and an echo with the earlier anthracycline dose checked

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。淋巴母细胞白血病/淋巴瘤用BFM类的急性淋巴细胞白血病式方案治疗（EURO-LB02，Landmann 2017）。中枢神经系统状态由有经验的医生在输注血小板后做诊断性腰穿、同时首剂鞘内注射来确定——外周血有原始细胞时穿刺损伤会使预后变差（Gajjar 2000）。遗传学和微小残留病决定危险度；既往方案没有记录，所以要先问清蒽环类累积剂量、查心脏功能，再用蒽环类。
feedback.en: Right. Lymphoblastic leukaemia/lymphoma is treated on ALL-type, BFM-derived protocols (EURO-LB02, Landmann 2017). CNS status comes from a diagnostic lumbar puncture by an experienced operator with the first intrathecal dose after platelet support — a traumatic tap with blasts in the blood worsens the outcome (Gajjar 2000). Genetics and MRD set the risk group, and because the earlier regimen is not recorded, find out its cumulative anthracycline dose and check cardiac function before giving more.

text.zh-CN: 按骨原发淋巴瘤治疗：CHOP类方案6个周期，并对原来的骨病变部位加局部放疗；脑脊液没有证明受累，所以不做鞘内治疗，也不需要腰椎穿刺
text.en: Treat it as a lymphoma of bone: six cycles of a CHOP-type regimen with radiotherapy to the original bone sites, and no intrathecal therapy or lumbar puncture because her CSF has not been shown to be involved

feedback.zh-CN: 淋巴母细胞淋巴瘤不按其他淋巴瘤治疗：短程CHOP类方案而不做中枢神经系统定向治疗，效果较差，标准是包括鞘内治疗的急性淋巴细胞白血病式方案（EURO-LB02，Landmann 2017）。她的脑脊液是“不知道”，不是“阴性”；对旧骨病变放疗针对的是肉瘤，而她没有肉瘤。
feedback.en: Lymphoblastic lymphoma is not treated like other lymphomas: short CHOP-type courses without CNS-directed therapy do worse, and ALL-type protocols with intrathecal therapy are the standard (EURO-LB02, Landmann 2017). Her CSF is unknown, not negative, and radiotherapy to the old bone sites treats a sarcoma she does not have.

text.zh-CN: 因为是6个疗程化疗后复发，先做一个高强度化疗疗程降低肿瘤负荷，配型找到供者后尽快行异基因造血干细胞移植
text.en: One block of high-intensity chemotherapy to reduce the disease, then an allogeneic stem-cell transplant as soon as a matched donor is found, because the disease came back after six courses of intensive chemotherapy

feedback.zh-CN: 急性淋巴细胞白血病是否移植，取决于遗传学和以微小残留病衡量的诱导反应，而这些现在都还不知道。这种病从未接受过针对急性淋巴细胞白血病的治疗——那6个疗程是为尤文肉瘤选的——所以起点是按急淋方案诱导（EURO-LB02，Landmann 2017），移植留给反应差或遗传学高危的情况。
feedback.en: Transplant decisions in ALL rest on the genetics and on the response to induction measured by MRD, none of which is known yet. This disease has never received ALL-directed therapy — the six courses were chosen for Ewing sarcoma — so induction on an ALL protocol comes first (EURO-LB02, Landmann 2017), with transplantation kept for a poor response or high-risk genetics.

text.zh-CN: 只做姑息治疗：病已在6个疗程强化疗后复发，再做治愈性治疗希望不大，只会增加痛苦
text.en: Palliative care only: the disease has come back after six courses of intensive chemotherapy, so more curative treatment is unlikely to help and would add suffering

feedback.zh-CN: 那6个疗程针对的是另一种肿瘤，所以这并不是急性淋巴细胞白血病治疗后的复发；淋巴母细胞肿瘤用急性淋巴细胞白血病式方案治疗，效果往往很好（EURO-LB02，Landmann 2017）。只给姑息治疗等于放弃一个真实的治愈机会；症状控制可以与治愈性治疗同时进行。
feedback.en: The six courses were aimed at a different tumour, so this is not a relapse after ALL treatment, and lymphoblastic neoplasms often respond well to ALL-type therapy (EURO-LB02, Landmann 2017). Offering palliation alone would withhold a real chance of cure; symptom control can run alongside curative treatment.

prompt.zh-CN: 家属问：“这么说，一开始的诊断错了？那六个疗程的化疗是不是白做了？这是谁的责任？”你怎么回答？
prompt.en: Her relative asks: “So the first diagnosis was wrong? Was all that chemotherapy for nothing? Whose fault is this?” How do you respond?

need.en: First answer decision 3: establish the diagnosis.

text.zh-CN: 直说诊断改变了及其原因——两种肿瘤在显微镜下很像，最初的检查分不开——体谅他们的痛苦，不猜测是谁的错，再讲清新的治疗计划
text.en: Say plainly that the diagnosis has changed and why — the two tumours look alike and the first tests could not separate them — acknowledge their distress, avoid guessing about fault, and set out the new plan

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。用SPIKES（Baile 2000）安排谈话：先了解家属已经知道什么、想知道多少，用平实的话说明诊断的改变，回应情绪，再讲计划。说明CD99和FLI-1是两种肿瘤共有的标记，是事实而不是指责；责任问题留给正式的复核，不在床旁推测。约好再谈，并用6岁孩子能懂的话跟她本人说明。
feedback.en: Right. Use SPIKES (Baile 2000): find out what they understand and want to know, give the change in plain words, respond to the emotion, then plan. Explaining that CD99 and FLI-1 are shared by both tumours is a fact, not an accusation; fault is for a proper review, not for speculation at the bedside. Offer a further meeting, and explain things to the girl in words a 6-year-old understands.

text.zh-CN: 安慰家属：最初的诊断合情合理，以前那六个疗程的化疗多半也已经治了这个病，所以什么都没有耽误，治疗只是照原来的路子接着做下去
text.en: Reassure them that the first diagnosis was perfectly reasonable and that the earlier chemotherapy will have treated this disease as well, so nothing has been lost and the treatment simply carries on as before

feedback.zh-CN: 这是不实的安慰：以前的方案对这种病有没有作用并不知道，治疗也不是“接着做”，而是改用急性淋巴细胞白血病方案。SPIKES（Baile 2000）要求如实、分步地说明坏消息；家属日后发现真相，会失去对正在治疗孩子的团队的信任。
feedback.en: This is false reassurance: whether the earlier regimen treated this disease is unknown, and treatment does not simply carry on — it changes to an ALL protocol. SPIKES (Baile 2000) asks for honest news given step by step; a family who later learns the truth loses trust in the team treating their child.

text.zh-CN: 告诉家属是外院没做TdT染色才漏诊的，以前的化疗用错了药，建议他们在开始新的治疗之前先去医院投诉
text.en: Tell them the other hospital missed the diagnosis by not doing a TdT stain, that the earlier chemotherapy was the wrong treatment, and that they should make a formal complaint before treatment starts

feedback.zh-CN: 在床旁推测另一个团队的过错既不公平也不可靠：最初的病理医生掌握了什么、做了什么并没有记录，而且这两种肿瘤本来就容易混淆（Lucas 2001）。要坦诚说明诊断已经改变，把责任问题留给正式的复核；家属可以通过正常渠道提出意见，但不应因此推迟治疗。
feedback.en: Speculating about another team's fault at the bedside is neither fair nor reliable: what the first pathologists had and did is not recorded, and these tumours are known to look alike (Lucas 2001). Be open that the diagnosis has changed and leave questions of fault to a proper review; the family can raise concerns through the usual route without delaying treatment.

text.zh-CN: 先不回答这个问题：告诉家属诱导治疗以后专科医生会再详细解释，今天只谈明天开始治疗需要签的知情同意书
text.en: Hold the question for now: say the specialists will go over it after induction, and keep today's conversation to the consent needed to start treatment tomorrow

feedback.zh-CN: 回避只会把问题推到更糟的时候，也让知情同意站不住：同意诱导治疗，需要先如实说明诊断为什么改变、新的治疗意味着什么（SPIKES，Baile 2000）。现在就回答，然后安排后续谈话。
feedback.en: Avoiding the question only moves it to a worse moment and weakens consent: agreeing to induction needs an honest account of why the diagnosis changed and what the new treatment involves (SPIKES, Baile 2000). Answer now, then arrange the further meeting.

text.zh-CN: 问清这次的发热、双腿疼痛、不能走路及其原因，最初发病的部位，外院的诊断、活检和化疗，以及她这两周用过什么药
text.en: Elicited this illness — fever, pain in both legs, inability to walk and whether weakness explains it — the first illness, the other hospital's diagnosis, biopsy and chemotherapy, and her medicines in the last two weeks

text.zh-CN: 测体温，查看面色和全身皮肤，触诊肝脾，并观察她能否站立行走
text.en: Took her temperature, looked at her colour and skin, palpated the liver and spleen and checked whether she could stand and walk

text.zh-CN: 入院时调阅外院骨活检报告和血常规、送检肿瘤溶解指标；确诊阶段调阅骨髓形态、流式细胞术和病理复核，并送检白血病遗传学
text.en: On admission read the outside biopsy report and the blood count and sent the tumour-lysis bloods; in the diagnostic phase read the marrow, flow cytometry and pathology review and sent the leukaemia genetics

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即判断骨髓已被淋巴母细胞肿瘤浸润并质疑原诊断，且申请复核原骨活检
text.en: Judged at the first attempt that a lymphoblastic neoplasm was infiltrating the marrow and questioned the first diagnosis, and requested a review of the original biopsy

text.zh-CN: 入院阶段先送血培养，再开始经验性静脉抗生素
text.en: In the admission phase, took blood cultures and then started an empirical IV antibiotic

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选对最初几小时的处置，复查血常规，并给予不含钾的水化、别嘌醇和对乙酰氨基酚，当天请儿童血液肿瘤科会诊
text.en: Chose the first-hours plan correctly at the first attempt, repeated the blood count, gave potassium-free hydration, allopurinol and paracetamol, and asked paediatric haematology-oncology to see her the same day

text.zh-CN: 没有按旧标签给尤文肉瘤化疗，也没有在诊断标本取得之前用激素或开始化疗
text.en: Gave no Ewing sarcoma chemotherapy on the old label, and no corticosteroid or chemotherapy before the diagnostic samples were taken

text.zh-CN: 血小板20×10⁹/L时没有用布洛芬，没有在复查前按7.1 g/L输红细胞，也没有在血小板升高前做腰穿
text.en: Avoided ibuprofen with platelets of 20 × 10⁹/L, red cells on the unverified haemoglobin of 7.1 g/L, and a lumbar puncture before the platelets were raised

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即判定原骨肿瘤是被当作尤文肉瘤的B淋巴母细胞淋巴瘤，现在按B淋巴母细胞白血病处理
text.en: Classified at the first attempt the original tumour as a B-lymphoblastic lymphoma taken for Ewing sarcoma, now managed as B-lymphoblastic leukaemia

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择儿童急淋方案，输血小板后做腰穿并鞘内注射，查超声心动图，并开始诱导治疗
text.en: Chose a paediatric ALL protocol at the first attempt, gave platelets before the lumbar puncture with intrathecal therapy, ordered an echocardiogram and started induction

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择坦诚说明诊断的改变，并与家属谈话
text.en: Chose at the first attempt to explain the changed diagnosis openly, and held the family meeting

text.zh-CN: 用SPIKES向家属坦诚说明诊断为什么改变、新的计划和不确定之处，并用孩子能懂的话跟她说明
text.en: Explained to the family with SPIKES why the diagnosis changed, the new plan and what is uncertain, and explained it to the girl at her level

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 良好表现（SPIKES，结合Calgary–Cambridge的结构）：选安静的房间，主治医生、血液肿瘤科医生和护士在场，陪同的家属在场，并请孩子的父母尽量都来；先问家属已经知道什么、想知道多少——他们以为“骨头上的肿瘤”已经缓解；用平实的话说明：骨髓里有大量不成熟的淋巴细胞，原来的骨活检复核后也是同一种淋巴母细胞肿瘤，过去当作尤文肉瘤治疗是因为两种肿瘤的部分染色相同；说明接下来按急性淋巴细胞白血病方案治疗、要做腰穿和更多检查，治愈的机会是真实的，但具体预后要等遗传学和治疗反应；不夸大、不猜测是谁的过错，承认家属的愤怒或自责，说明有正式的途径提出疑问；用回授法确认理解，约好下次谈话并记录。另外用6岁孩子能懂的话、在家属同意下跟她本人说明要做什么、会不会疼。不要给出没有依据的生存率，不要说以前的化疗“也治了这个病”，不要推迟回答到治疗之后。
judgeGuidance.en: Good performance (SPIKES within a Calgary–Cambridge structure): a quiet room with the attending, the haemato-oncologist and a nurse, the relative who is here and both parents invited if possible; first asks what the family knows and wants to know — they believe the “bone tumour” is in remission; explains in plain words that the marrow is full of immature lymphocytes, that the review of the original bone biopsy shows the same lymphoblastic tumour, and that it was treated as Ewing sarcoma because the two tumours share some of the stains; explains that treatment now follows an ALL protocol with a lumbar puncture and further tests, that the chance of cure is real but the outlook depends on the genetics and the response; neither overstates nor guesses whose fault it was, acknowledges anger or self-blame, and names the formal route for questions; checks understanding by teach-back, agrees when to talk again and records it. With the family's agreement, also explains to the girl in words a 6-year-old understands what will happen and whether it will hurt. No survival figures without a source, no claim that the earlier chemotherapy “treated this too”, no deferring the answer until after treatment.

name.zh-CN: 岑医生（儿科主治医师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 儿科主治医师，用苏格拉底式提问带教，按PEARLS复盘，只围绕学员已经得到的资料提问，例如：“她的哪些体征能告诉你骨髓里出了什么事？”“外院那份病理到底证明了什么？同样的染色在别的肿瘤里会是什么样？”“骨髓结果出来之前，接下来几小时什么可能伤害她？哪些看似合理的做法会让情况更糟？”“一个写作7.1 g/L的血红蛋白，你会怎么处理？”“哪些标记确定系别？叫淋巴瘤还是白血病，对治疗有没有影响？”“家属问一开始是不是诊断错了，你怎么说？”说明这份报告发表于2011年，当时的检查范围与现在不同，它的病程不能用来评价现在的治疗。不提前透露诊断、决策答案或转归，陷阱和答案留到复盘时再讲；中性粒细胞计数、真实的血红蛋白、乳酸脱氢酶和电解质、凝血、培养、脑脊液、遗传学、微小残留病、以前的化疗药物、任何影像、双腿的神经系统查体、体重和过敏史都没有记录，不要替它补上。
knowledge.en: Paediatric attending who teaches by Socratic questions and debriefs with PEARLS, asking only about what the learner already has, e.g. “Which of her signs tell you what is happening in her marrow?”, “What exactly did the outside pathology prove — and what would the same stains look like in another tumour?”, “Before the marrow result, what could harm her in the next hours, and which reasonable-looking steps would make it worse?”, “What will you do with a haemoglobin written as 7.1 g/L?”, “Which markers set the lineage, and does it matter for treatment whether you call it lymphoma or leukaemia?”, “What will you say when the family asks whether the first diagnosis was wrong?”. Explains that the report was published in 2011: its testing differs from today's, and its course is no measure of treatment now. Never reveals the diagnosis, a decision's answer or the outcome early, and keeps the traps for the debrief; the neutrophil count, the true haemoglobin, LDH and electrolytes, clotting, cultures, the CSF, the genetics, MRD, the earlier chemotherapy drugs, any imaging, the neurological examination of her legs, her weight and her allergies are not recorded — never supply them.

name.zh-CN: 梁护士（儿科病房）

knowledge.zh-CN: 儿科病房护士。交班（ISBAR）：6岁女孩，由家属陪同入院；曾在外院按骨肿瘤化疗6个疗程，评估为完全缓解；近2周发热、双下肢疼痛，现在不能行走；入院体温38.6 ℃。可以协助建立静脉通路和采血（含血培养）、用输液泵补液、联系血库、记录出入量，并配合医生安排骨髓穿刺和腰穿的镇静。复述医嘱，只报告已经出来的结果，不解读、不诊断；被问到没有记录的内容（其余生命体征、体重、这两周用过的药、过敏史）时直接说没有记录。
knowledge.en: Children's ward nurse. Handover (ISBAR): 6-year-old girl admitted with a relative; treated elsewhere for a bone tumour with six courses of chemotherapy and assessed as in complete remission; two weeks of fever and pain in both legs, now unable to walk; temperature 38.6 °C on admission. Can help with IV access and bloods (including cultures), fluids on an infusion pump, the blood bank and the fluid-balance chart, and with sedation for the marrow and the lumbar puncture alongside the doctors. Reads orders back, reports only results that are back, never interprets or diagnoses, and says plainly when something is not recorded (her other vital signs, her weight, the medicines she has had in the last two weeks, her allergies).

name.zh-CN: 麦医生（病理科）

knowledge.zh-CN: 病理科医生，只解读学员已经看过的病理和骨髓结果。可以讲：儿童骨的小圆细胞肿瘤的鉴别（尤文肉瘤、淋巴母细胞淋巴瘤、横纹肌肉瘤、神经母细胞瘤等）；CD99和FLI-1蛋白在淋巴母细胞淋巴瘤中也表达，单靠它们不能诊断尤文肉瘤（Folpe 2000；Lucas 2001）；区分需要TdT、CD45、CD43、CD79a/PAX5、CD19、CD10、CD3等组合；有疑问时靠EWSR1重排或FET::ETS融合的分子检测定论——WHO软组织和骨肿瘤分类第5版（2020）正是以这种融合定义尤文肉瘤；组织切片上的CD3免疫组化会染到反应性T细胞；WHO造血与淋巴组织肿瘤分类第5版（2022）的定系原则。不提前给出决策答案或转归，不补充没有记录的结果（例如EWSR1、遗传学）。
knowledge.en: Pathologist who interprets only pathology and marrow results the learner has already read. Can explain the differential of small round cell tumours of bone in children (Ewing sarcoma, lymphoblastic lymphoma, rhabdomyosarcoma, neuroblastoma and others); that CD99 and FLI-1 protein are also expressed by lymphoblastic lymphoma and cannot make a diagnosis of Ewing sarcoma on their own (Folpe 2000; Lucas 2001); that separating them needs a panel with TdT, CD45, CD43, CD79a/PAX5, CD19, CD10 and CD3, and that a molecular test for an EWSR1 rearrangement or FET::ETS fusion — the alteration that defines Ewing sarcoma in the WHO Classification of Soft Tissue and Bone Tumours, 5th edition (2020) — settles a doubtful case; that a CD3 immunostain in a tissue section also stains reactive T cells; and the lineage rules of the WHO Classification of Haematolymphoid Tumours, 5th edition (2022). Never gives a decision's answer or the outcome early, and adds no result the case does not record (EWSR1, genetics).

name.zh-CN: 邱医生（儿童血液肿瘤科会诊）

knowledge.zh-CN: 儿童血液肿瘤科会诊医生，只解读学员已经看过的血液和骨髓结果。可以讲：可疑急性白血病患儿发热时，在中性粒细胞计数明确之前按高危发热伴中性粒细胞减少处理，先留血培养，尽快用抗假单胞菌β-内酰胺类等单药（国际儿童发热伴中性粒细胞减少指南，2023年更新）；肿瘤溶解危险分层和预防（TLS专家共识，Cairo 2010）；BSH 2016的儿童输血阈值（病情稳定者血红蛋白70 g/L；预防性血小板一般<10×10⁹/L，脓毒症或严重黏膜炎时<20×10⁹/L，操作前另定）；诊断性腰穿要在输血小板后由有经验的医生与首剂鞘注一起做（Gajjar 2000）；淋巴母细胞淋巴瘤和白血病都用急性淋巴细胞白血病式方案（EURO-LB02，Landmann 2017），按遗传学和微小残留病分层，并核对既往蒽环类累积剂量。不提前给出决策答案或转归，不补充没有记录的结果。
knowledge.en: Paediatric haematology-oncology consultant who interprets only blood and marrow results the learner has already read. Can explain that fever in a child with a suspected acute leukaemia is managed as high-risk febrile neutropenia until the neutrophil count is known — cultures, then an antipseudomonal β-lactam or similar as monotherapy as soon as possible (international paediatric fever-and-neutropenia guideline, 2023 update); tumour-lysis risk and prophylaxis (TLS expert panel, Cairo 2010); the BSH 2016 thresholds for children (haemoglobin 70 g/L when stable; prophylactic platelets usually below 10 × 10⁹/L, below 20 × 10⁹/L with sepsis or severe mucositis, higher before procedures); that the diagnostic lumbar puncture is done after platelet support by an experienced operator with the first intrathecal dose (Gajjar 2000); and that lymphoblastic lymphoma and leukaemia both receive ALL-type protocols (EURO-LB02, Landmann 2017), risk-stratified by genetics and MRD, with the earlier cumulative anthracycline dose checked. Never gives a decision's answer or the outcome early, and adds no result the case does not record.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：被当作尤文肉瘤治疗的B淋巴母细胞淋巴瘤
title.en: Debrief: a B-lymphoblastic lymphoma treated as Ewing sarcoma

conclusion.zh-CN: 6岁女孩曾在外院按“尤文肉瘤”治疗：骨破坏、小圆细胞肿瘤，CD99、FLI-1和CD3阳性，CD20阴性，没有TdT记录；6个疗程化疗后评估为完全缓解。这次发热2周、双下肢疼痛、不能行走：体温38.6 ℃，贫血貌，散在出血点，肝肋下3 cm、脾肋下2.5 cm，白细胞42.38×10⁹/L、淋巴细胞91%，血小板20×10⁹/L，血红蛋白记为7.1 g/L。骨髓原始及幼稚淋巴细胞84.5%，流式细胞术表达CD10、CD19、CD79a、HLA-DR和CD34；复核原骨活检和本次骨髓，TdT、CD99阳性，CD79部分阳性：这是被误诊为尤文肉瘤的B淋巴母细胞淋巴瘤，现已广泛累及骨髓。改用儿童淋巴母细胞方案后，第8天外周血幼稚细胞为0，第33天完全缓解，报告发表时在维持治疗。按今天的标准：诊断尤文肉瘤前要做淋巴系标记和EWSR1检测；发热先培养、再用抗生素；取标本前不用激素；血红蛋白先复查；按微小残留病指导的急淋方案治疗，并评估中枢神经系统。
conclusion.en: A 6-year-old girl was treated elsewhere for “Ewing sarcoma” — bone destruction and a small round cell tumour, CD99, FLI-1 and CD3 positive, CD20 negative, no TdT recorded — and assessed as in complete remission after six courses of chemotherapy. Now, after two weeks of fever and pain in both legs, she cannot walk: 38.6 °C, pallor, scattered petechiae, liver 3 cm and spleen 2.5 cm below the costal margins, white cells 42.38 × 10⁹/L with 91 % lymphocytes, platelets 20 × 10⁹/L, haemoglobin written as 7.1 g/L. Marrow: lymphoblasts and immature lymphocytes 84.5 %; flow cytometry CD10, CD19, CD79a, HLA-DR and CD34; review of the original biopsy and the new marrow TdT and CD99 positive, CD79 partly positive — a B-lymphoblastic lymphoma misdiagnosed as Ewing sarcoma, now extensively involving the marrow. On a paediatric lymphoblastic regimen: no immature cells in the blood on day 8, complete remission on day 33, maintenance at publication. Today: lymphoid markers and EWSR1 testing before a Ewing diagnosis; cultures, then antibiotics; no steroid before the samples; a re-measured haemoglobin; and an MRD-guided ALL protocol with CNS staging.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 发热、双腿疼痛、面色苍白、出血点、肝脾肿大、以淋巴细胞为主的白细胞升高加上血小板减少，在证明是别的病之前都提示骨髓被浸润，不管她带着什么旧诊断来。
keyReasoning.en: Fever, pain in both legs, pallor, petechiae, an enlarged liver and spleen, a lymphocyte-predominant leucocytosis and thrombocytopenia mean marrow infiltration until shown otherwise, whatever label she arrives with.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 最初的诊断只依据CD99和FLI-1，而这两个标记淋巴母细胞淋巴瘤也有；肿瘤还是CD3阳性，没有TdT和分子检测——那只是一个工作标签，不是证据。
keyReasoning.en: The first diagnosis rested on CD99 and FLI-1, both shared with lymphoblastic lymphoma, in a CD3-positive tumour with no TdT and no molecular test: a working label, not a proof.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 骨髓结果出来之前，危险是感染、出血和肿瘤溶解；让它们更糟的是取标本前用激素、用非甾体抗炎药、按不可能的数值输血，以及按旧标签给肉瘤化疗。
keyReasoning.en: Before the marrow result the dangers are sepsis, bleeding and tumour lysis, and the steps that worsen them are steroids before the samples, NSAIDs, a transfusion on an impossible number and sarcoma chemotherapy on the old label.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: TdT加上CD19、CD79a和CD10，而且复核首次活检时同样记录到TdT，说明是同一个B淋巴母细胞肿瘤，而不是两种病；旧的CD3结果是留给病理医生的问题，不是第二个系别。
keyReasoning.en: TdT with CD19, CD79a and CD10 — and TdT recorded on review of the first biopsy too — make one B-lymphoblastic neoplasm, not two diseases; the old CD3 result is a question for the pathologist, not a second lineage.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 叫淋巴瘤也好、白血病也好，治疗都是急性淋巴细胞白血病式方案；仍待明确的是分期（中枢神经系统、遗传学、微小残留病）和已经承受过的毒性。
keyReasoning.en: Lymphoma or leukaemia, the treatment is ALL-type; what remains open is staging — CNS, genetics, MRD — and the toxicity already given.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是2011年发表的单例报告：不能用来比较治疗方法，不能估计尤文肉瘤被误诊的频率，也不能据此判断这个孩子的预后。病例事实沿用1.0.0版的提取内容，尚未对照原文全文核对；治疗药物和剂量、脑脊液、遗传学、微小残留病和长期结局都没有记录，病例也不模拟生理变化。决策、处置选项、评分和教学要点是依据现行指南的教学设计，不改变已发表的病程。
boundaries.en: This is a single case report published in 2011: it cannot compare treatments, estimate how often Ewing sarcoma is misdiagnosed, or give this child's prognosis. The case facts are those extracted for version 1.0.0 and have not yet been checked against the full article; the treatment drugs and doses, the CSF, genetics, MRD and the long-term outcome are not recorded, and no physiology is simulated. The decisions, management options, scoring and teaching points are teaching design based on current guidance and do not change the published course.

unknowns.zh-CN: 中性粒细胞计数、真实的血红蛋白（记为7.1 g/L）、血涂片，以及开始新方案之前的任何复查血常规。
unknowns.en: The neutrophil count, the true haemoglobin (written as 7.1 g/L), the blood film, and any repeat count before the new regimen.

unknowns.zh-CN: 入院时的电解质、尿酸、磷、钙、肌酐、乳酸脱氢酶、凝血功能、血培养和体温以外的生命体征。
unknowns.en: Electrolytes, urate, phosphate, calcium, creatinine, LDH, clotting, blood cultures and the vital signs other than temperature on admission.

unknowns.zh-CN: 骨破坏是影像学所见还是病理所见、累及哪些骨、活检取自哪里，以及首次发病和这次住院的任何影像。
unknowns.en: Whether the bone destruction was seen on imaging or in the biopsy, which bones were involved, where the biopsy was taken, and any imaging of the first illness or of this admission.

unknowns.zh-CN: 此前6个疗程化疗的药物、剂量和时间（包括蒽环类），是否放疗或手术，以及缓解维持了多久。
unknowns.en: The drugs, doses and dates of the six earlier courses (including any anthracycline), any radiotherapy or surgery, and how long the remission lasted.

unknowns.zh-CN: 是否做过EWSR1检测；首次活检的CD3阳性是在肿瘤细胞上还是在背景淋巴细胞上；首次发病时是否做过骨髓检查。
unknowns.en: Whether EWSR1 testing was ever done; whether the CD3 positivity of the first biopsy was in the tumour cells or in background lymphocytes; whether the marrow was examined at the first illness.

unknowns.zh-CN: 脑脊液结果、细胞遗传学和分子遗传学、微小残留病、新方案的药物和剂量，以及维持治疗以后的结局。
unknowns.en: The CSF, cytogenetics and molecular genetics, MRD, the drugs and doses of the new regimen, and the outcome after maintenance.

unknowns.zh-CN: 双下肢的神经系统查体、体重、过敏史、疫苗接种和家族史。
unknowns.en: The neurological examination of her legs, her weight, allergies, vaccinations and family history.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 小圆细胞肿瘤的病理：CD99和FLI-1蛋白在淋巴母细胞淋巴瘤中同样表达（Folpe，Am J Surg Pathol 2000；Lucas，Am J Clin Pathol 2001），所以免疫组化组合必须包括TdT和B、T系标记；WHO软组织和骨肿瘤分类（第5版，2020）以FET::ETS融合定义尤文肉瘤，有疑问的病例要靠分子检测来定论。本例首次活检CD3阳性、CD20阴性、没有TdT记录，复核发现TdT阳性——这样的检查放在今天是不完整的。
teachingPoints.en: Pathology of small round cell tumours: CD99 and FLI-1 protein are expressed by lymphoblastic lymphoma as well as Ewing sarcoma (Folpe, Am J Surg Pathol 2000; Lucas, Am J Clin Pathol 2001), so the panel must include TdT and B- and T-lineage markers, and the WHO Classification of Soft Tissue and Bone Tumours (5th edition, 2020) defines Ewing sarcoma by a FET::ETS fusion, so a molecular test is what settles a doubtful case. Here the first biopsy was CD3 positive and CD20 negative with no TdT recorded, and the review found TdT positivity — a work-up that would be incomplete today.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 可疑急性白血病患儿发热：中性粒细胞计数不明时按高危发热伴中性粒细胞减少处理——先送血培养，尽快用抗假单胞菌β-内酰胺类、第四代头孢菌素或碳青霉烯类单药经验治疗（国际儿童发热伴中性粒细胞减少指南，J Clin Oncol 2023），例如哌拉西林他唑巴坦90 mg/kg、每6小时1次（单次最大4.5 g）。血小板20×10⁹/L时退热用对乙酰氨基酚，不用非甾体抗炎药。本病例没有记录是否用过抗生素。
teachingPoints.en: Fever with a suspected acute leukaemia: with the neutrophil count unknown, treat as high-risk febrile neutropenia — blood cultures, then empirical monotherapy with an antipseudomonal β-lactam, a fourth-generation cephalosporin or a carbapenem as soon as possible (international paediatric fever-and-neutropenia guideline, J Clin Oncol 2023), e.g. piperacillin–tazobactam 90 mg/kg every 6 hours (maximum 4.5 g per dose). With platelets of 20 × 10⁹/L, paracetamol rather than an NSAID. This case does not record whether antibiotics were given.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 细胞毒治疗之前：可能的急性淋巴细胞白血病、白细胞42.38×10⁹/L、乳酸脱氢酶不明，至少属于肿瘤溶解中危（TLS专家共识，Br J Haematol 2010）——不含钾的水化、别嘌醇，并查电解质、尿酸、磷、钙、肌酐和乳酸脱氢酶。骨髓、流式和脑脊液标本取得之前不用激素、不开始化疗：激素会溶解淋巴母细胞，使诊断和危险度分组无法完成，并可能诱发肿瘤溶解。
teachingPoints.en: Before cytotoxic treatment: a probable ALL with a white count of 42.38 × 10⁹/L and an unknown LDH is at least intermediate risk for tumour lysis (TLS expert panel, Br J Haematol 2010) — potassium-free hydration, allopurinol, and electrolytes, urate, phosphate, calcium, creatinine and LDH. No corticosteroid or chemotherapy before the marrow, flow cytometry and CSF samples: steroids lyse lymphoblasts, can leave the diagnosis and risk group incomplete, and can precipitate lysis.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 不可信的数据：写作7.1 g/L的血红蛋白与生命不相容，很可能是单位或录入错误（7.1 g/dL即71 g/L）。既不照它处置，也不悄悄改写；复查后按实测值和BSH 2016的阈值决定（病情稳定的儿童70 g/L）。BSH 2016对病情稳定的儿童在血小板<10×10⁹/L时预防性输注（脓毒症或严重黏膜炎时<20×10⁹/L），操作前另有要求。
teachingPoints.en: Data you cannot trust: a haemoglobin written as 7.1 g/L is incompatible with life and is probably a unit or transcription error (7.1 g/dL is 71 g/L). Neither act on it nor “correct” it silently; repeat the count and decide on the measured value against the BSH 2016 threshold of 70 g/L for stable children. BSH 2016 gives prophylactic platelets below 10 × 10⁹/L in stable children (below 20 with sepsis or severe mucositis), with separate thresholds before procedures.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 治疗：B淋巴母细胞白血病/淋巴瘤（WHO第5版，2022）不论叫哪个名字，都用BFM类的急性淋巴细胞白血病式方案（EURO-LB02，Haematologica 2017）；骨髓原始细胞25%是习惯上称为白血病的界线。原报告改用儿童淋巴母细胞方案，记录第8天外周血幼稚细胞为0、第33天完全缓解——正是BFM类方案评估治疗反应的时间点。今天还要在输注血小板后做腰穿并首剂鞘注以评估中枢神经系统（外周血有原始细胞时穿刺损伤使预后变差，Blood 2000），查遗传学和微小残留病，并核对既往蒽环类剂量。
teachingPoints.en: Treatment: B-lymphoblastic leukaemia/lymphoma (WHO 5th edition, 2022) is treated on ALL-type, BFM-derived protocols whichever name it carries (EURO-LB02, Haematologica 2017); 25 % marrow blasts is the conventional line for calling it leukaemia. The report's team changed to a paediatric lymphoblastic regimen and records no immature cells in the blood on day 8 and remission on day 33 — the response time points of BFM-type protocols. Today add CNS staging by a lumbar puncture with the first intrathecal dose after platelet support (a traumatic tap with blasts in the blood worsens the outcome, Blood 2000), genetics, MRD and a check of the earlier anthracycline dose.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 告诉家属诊断改变了：用SPIKES（Baile，Oncologist 2000）——环境、认知、邀请、告知、共情、计划——用平实的话说明改变了什么、为什么，不给不实的安慰，不推测另一个团队的过错，并用孩子能懂的话跟她本人说明。本病例没有记录家属被告知了什么。
teachingPoints.en: Telling a family that the diagnosis has changed: use SPIKES (Baile, Oncologist 2000) — setting, perception, invitation, knowledge, emotions, strategy — and say what changed and why in plain words, without false reassurance and without speculating about another team's fault, then give the child an explanation at her level. This case does not record what the family was told.

testUtterances.text: 这次孩子是哪里不好，怎么又住进来了？
So what's been going on with her over the last couple of weeks?
发烧几天了，最高烧到多少？
How long has she been running temperatures, and how hot has she got?
宝贝，告诉阿姨哪儿疼？
Can you show me where it's sore, poppet?
现在还能下地自己走吗？
Are you able to get up and walk about at all?
腿是没劲儿还是疼得走不了？大小便正常吗？
Is it weakness in her legs, or any numbness, or trouble with her bladder?
最近流过鼻血或者身上青一块紫一块吗？
Any nosebleeds or bruising you've spotted?
Has she been sweating at night or losing weight?
Any coughing, earache or a tummy bug along with the fever?
最早是哪里先疼起来的？
Take me right back to the very start — what was the first thing that happened?
当初疼的地方有没有肿起来？
这一年多是一直疼，还是断断续续的？
Has the pain been there constantly, or does it come and go?
刚开始那会儿有没有发烧、贫血？
Did anyone do a bone marrow back at the beginning?
外院当时说她得的是什么病？
What were you told it was at the other hospital?
当时取过组织做病理吗？
How did they prove it — did someone take a biopsy?
化疗一共做了几个疗程，效果怎么样？
How many rounds of chemo did she get, and did it work?
化疗具体用了哪些药，你还记得吗？
How long did she stay well once the treatment stopped?
这两周有没有给她吃过激素或者止痛药？
Is she allergic to penicillin or any antibiotic?
家里有没有人得过白血病或者癌症？
预防针都打全了吗？
Do you know how heavy she is these days?
您现在最怕的是什么？
Now the marrow results are in, what's on your mind?
你们住在哪个区？
孩子平时上哪个幼儿园？
Which school does she go to?
Did you manage to find parking all right?
